result.title: Towards Agentic Video Corpus Moment Retrieval
result.summary: Video corpus moment retrieval (VCMR) requires finding the video and time interval that match a text query in a corpus of videos. We present RELAY, a training-free framework for VCMR that shares memory across queries. RELAY processes a batch of queries in three stages: search with a query bank, ranking with video notes, and localization with video prompt caching. In the search stage, an embedding model scores each video by its best-matching frame. The query bank penalizes videos that score highly for many other queries in the batch. In the ranking stage, a vision-language model (VLM) writes notes on each candidate video's scenes, people, objects, and actions once. Then, a large language model (LLM) reranks the candidates from these notes. In the localization stage, a VLM predicts the time interval of the moment in the top-ranked video. When multiple queries select the same video, prompt caching lets the VLM reuse its frames. On the three VERIFIED benchmarks, RELAY outperforms the trained baselines in video retrieval R@1 without training. Without any labeled moment, its predicted intervals are shorter than the annotated ones. In VCMR, it achieves similar performance to VideoSearch-R1 on one benchmark and trails it at IoU 0.5 on the other two. Human annotators also mark shorter moments than the original annotations of the benchmarks. A single margin, calibrated on a few labeled queries, widens the predicted interval to the annotation convention of the benchmarks. With it, RELAY outperforms the trained baselines in VCMR at IoU 0.5.

AI.brief_summary: 提出免训练的 VCMR 框架 RELAY：用批内 query bank 抑制热门视频偏置，VLM 为候选视频一次性生成场景与实体笔记供 LLM 重排，再由 VLM 定位时刻，并通过 prompt caching 在多个查询选中同一视频时复用帧。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「视频笔记」式证据压缩、跨查询记忆复用与帧缓存机制，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选、中间状态缓存及匹配贡献分配提供可核查线索，但论文并未研究 latent 推理状态或推理期计算调度。
